summary: Forest Service lookout in Clackamas County, Oregon: an L-4 cab from 1937-40 came down in 1977 or 1996 (sources disagree); the octagonal cab dates to 1997 and is staffed in summer.

facts.design: Current cab is octagonal and live-in on a laminated wood tower; the original was an L-4 cab on a 41-ft timber tower

events.note: L-4 cab on a 41-foot timber tower, per NHLR and FireLookout.com; the state survey gives about 1937
NHLR's date, with historic parts salvaged; disputed by FireLookout.com and the 1992 condition report
Jensen condition report on the old tower recommended its replacement
Present octagonal cab on a laminated wood tower, per NHLR's Built field

corrections.proposed: Octagonal live-in cab on a laminated wood tower (current); L-4 cab was on the removed 41-ft timber tower
corrections.why: L-4 describes the original 1940 cab on a timber tower, not the present structure

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and FireLookout.com say 1940; the state survey, citing Kresek (1984), says about 1937. The story reports both.

NHLR says 1977; FireLookout.com says 1996. The 1992 condition report recommending replacement of the old tower suggests it was still standing that year. The story says the question is open and does not settle it.
NHLR gives a 40-ft laminated wood tower under the cab; FireLookout.com gives a 50-ft pole tower. The record keeps 15.2 m (50 ft).
NHLR gives 1,682 m (5,520 ft); FireLookout.com gives 5617 ft. The record keeps NHLR's 1682.5 m.

notes_for_editor: Build year (about 1937 vs 1940) and removal year (1977 vs 1996) conflict; the 1992 survey is the best tiebreak but is not a Forest Service record. Access and visiting rules were not confirmed from a Forest Service page. No fire detections found. Trip-report pages seen only in search snippets (oregonhikers, cherylhill, oregonlookouts) were not read or cited. Quotes checked against the cached pages. Fact-check 2026-10-08: story reworded where it went beyond the sources ("first lookout", "today"); Clackamas County evidence added.
